summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a male with a history of mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma involving the central nervous system and eyes, was admitted for his eleventh cycle of high-dose methotrexate and rituximab chemotherapy. He presented in stable condition with only stable bilateral eye floaters and no new neurological or systemic symptoms. He received methotrexate at 6 g/m² with leucovorin rescue, hydration, and urinary alkalinization for renal protection, along with rituximab premedicated with dexamethasone and Benadryl. Methotrexate levels declined appropriately, reaching 0.13 µM by the day before discharge. A brain MRI showed no evidence of lymphoma recurrence, with findings unchanged from prior studies. He tolerated treatment well without acute toxicity or complications. He was discharged home in stable condition on aspirin, multivitamin, and PRN eye drops, with instructions to complete leucovorin and attend follow-up in two weeks.
